app.name: Iki Tekerli
app.tagline: Buy, sell, service and rent two-wheelers
app.description: Azerbaijan's marketplace for motorcycles, scooters, electric vehicles and bicycles — buy, sell, find parts, book a workshop, or rent by the day.

errors.notFoundBody: This listing may have been sold, rented out, or taken down by a moderator.
errors.genericBody: We couldn't load this screen. Give it another try.

preview.hint: Iki Tekerli is a mobile product. Open it on a phone, or resize this window.

onboarding.slide1Body: Motorcycles, scooters, electric vehicles and bicycles — new and used, from private sellers and dealers across Azerbaijan.
onboarding.slide2Title: Rent by the day, not by chance
onboarding.slide2Body: Real availability calendars, transparent deposits and an agreement signed by SMS. No more negotiating over chat.
onboarding.slide3Body: Search parts by your exact make and model, and book a rated workshop straight from the listing.
onboarding.slide4Title: Deals that stay on the platform
onboarding.slide4Body: Full chat history, reviews only after a completed rental, and contacts revealed once a booking is confirmed.

favorites.emptyBody: Tap the heart on any listing to keep it here.

account.title: Account
account.demoNote: Demo account. Sign-in, listing management and notifications are part of the full product.

install.title: Install the app
install.body: Add it to your home screen — opens without a browser
install.pageLead: Added to your phone in one tap. No download, no sign-up, no app store.
install.androidSteps: Tap the button below and choose Install. If the button is missing: browser menu (⋮) → Install app.
install.iosSteps: Tap the Share icon (□↑) below, then choose Add to Home Screen.
install.desktopSteps: Click the install icon at the right of the address bar. Open it on a phone for the best experience.
install.benefit1: Its own icon on your home screen
install.benefit3: Pages you have visited work without a connection
